name: Vigil
install: { command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql-client; }; } && sudo python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --ignore-installed -r requirements.lock -r requirements-dev.txt 'bandit[toml]' && npm ci --prefix clients/web && npm ci --prefix services/agent && sudo bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if trivy --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Version: 0.73.0"; then exit 0; fi; ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture); case "$ARCH" in amd64) TARCH=64bit; TSUM=2edd39da482bb4e9831962487b68f68e3928ec3137794757f54d00383d79547b ;; arm64) TARCH=ARM64; TSUM=13833d97e8a1a5367471c372a173180157f593bece570e20d5d925fef552f5dd ;; *) echo "unsupported arch $ARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; TV=0.73.0; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf $tmp" EXIT; curl --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -fsSL -o "$tmp/trivy.tar.gz" "https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/download/v${TV}/trivy_${TV}_Linux-${TARCH}.tar.gz"; echo "${TSUM}  $tmp/trivy.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xzf "$tmp/trivy.tar.gz" -C "$tmp" trivy; install -m 0755 "$tmp/trivy" /usr/local/bin/trivy; trivy --version' && helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami --force-update && helm repo add open-telemetry https://open-telemetry.github.io/opentelemetry-helm-charts --force-update && helm dependency build infra/helm/vigil && for tgz in infra/helm/vigil/charts/*.tgz; do tar -xzf "$tgz" -C infra/helm/vigil/charts/; done
start: bash -lc 'sudo service docker start || true; set -euo pipefail; for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "docker daemon did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis bifrost; for i in $(seq 1 60); do if docker exec deeptempo-postgres pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U deeptempo -d deeptempo_soc >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker exec deeptempo-redis redis-cli ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG; then break; fi; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "postgres/redis did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8080/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "bifrost did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; PSQL="docker exec deeptempo-postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U deeptempo -d postgres"; $PSQL -q -c "DO \$d\$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = \$q\$vigil\$q\$) THEN CREATE ROLE vigil LOGIN PASSWORD \$q\$vigil\$q\$; END IF; END \$d\$;"; $PSQL -tAq -c "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = \$q\$vigil_test\$q\$" | grep -q 1 || $PSQL -q -c "CREATE DATABASE vigil_test OWNER vigil"; DB_STRICT_SCHEMA=true python -c "from core.storage.connection import init_database; init_database()"; python scripts/seed_reference_data.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; for f in 19_agent_ledger 31_agent_ledger_hash_chain 20_agent_directives 21_agent_run_leases; do docker exec deeptempo-postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -U deeptempo -d deeptempo_soc -f /db-init/$f.sql >/dev/null; done; docker rm -f vigil-ci-postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker run -d --name vigil-ci-postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=deeptempo_test -e POSTGRES_USER=test -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test -p 127.0.0.1:5433:5432 postgres:16-alpine >/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker exec vigil-ci-postgres pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U test -d deeptempo_test >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "CI test postgres did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; printf "%s\n" TESTING=true POSTGRES_HOST=localhost POSTGRES_PORT=5433 POSTGRES_USER=test POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test POSTGRES_DB=deeptempo_test DATABASE_URL=postgresql://test:test@localhost:5433/deeptempo_test > "$HOME/vigil-ci-test.env"; CIPSQL="docker exec -i vigil-ci-postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -U test -d deeptempo_test"; $CIPSQL -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;"; (set -a; . "$HOME/vigil-ci-test.env"; DB_STRICT_SCHEMA=true python -c "from core.storage.connection import init_database; init_database()"); for f in 19_agent_ledger 31_agent_ledger_hash_chain 20_agent_directives 21_agent_run_leases; do $CIPSQL -c "SET client_min_messages = warning" -f - < infra/database/init/$f.sql >/dev/null; done; bash scripts/agent_testdb.sh; [ -f .env ] || cp env.example .env; for k in JWT_SECRET_KEY AGENT_INTERNAL_TOKEN; do sed -i "s|^$k=\"\"\$|$k=\"$(python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))")\"|" .env; done; mkdir -p logs; (set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export PYTHONPATH=$PWD BIFROST_URL=http://localhost:8080; setsid nohup uvicorn services.api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 6987 --reload --reload-dir services --reload-dir core --reload-dir tools </dev/null >logs/backend.log 2>&1 & setsid nohup python -m services.worker </dev/null >logs/llm_worker.log 2>&1 &); (cd clients/web && setsid nohup npm run dev </dev/null >../../logs/frontend.log 2>&1 &); bash scripts/agent_up.sh; for port in 6990 6989; do curl -sf -m 2 "http://127.0.0.1:$port/healthz" >/dev/null || { echo "agent layer did not become ready on :$port" >&2; exit 1; }; done; if [ ! -d infra/helm/vigil/charts/postgresql ] || [ ! -d infra/helm/vigil/charts/redis ] || [ ! -d infra/helm/vigil/charts/opentelemetry-collector ]; then helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami --force-update && helm repo add open-telemetry https://open-telemetry.github.io/opentelemetry-helm-charts --force-update && helm dependency build infra/helm/vigil && for tgz in infra/helm/vigil/charts/*.tgz; do tar -xzf "$tgz" -C infra/helm/vigil/charts/; done; fi'
